change.description: Recover release preparation and failed frozen-input operations when the release ledger is headed by a valid legacy web-flow commit, and bind the signed recovery commit to that legacy head.
change.release_unit_description: static frontend and full-feature Docker image

planned.reasoning: This is a backward-compatible release recovery fix. It admits only a valid legacy signed ledger head for release preparation and the existing abandon-failed-inputs operation, then records an explicit recovery marker in the signed commit message.

current.reasoning: Release preparation and cleanup read legacy heads only with the existing signed recovery checks, preserve their existing guards, and use the ledger compare-and-swap recovery marker without changing release identity or product artifacts.

scope_drift.description: The change is limited to the failed-input recovery command and its signed ledger CAS regression coverage.

verified.reasoning: Focused ledger, provenance, completion, and recovery tests pass, including the legacy-head recovery marker contract. The release ledger JSON shape and shipped product contracts remain unchanged.

persistent_state.state_description: The change does not alter the release ledger JSON schema, frozen artifact identity, SQLite schema, or browser persistence; it adds only signed commit-message provenance for a legacy-head recovery.

evidence.command: The existing ledger JSON transition remains the only durable state mutation; recovery provenance is carried in the signed commit message.
